items.quote:
When the five men went into Micah’s house and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”
19  They answered him, “Be quiet!
items.contrast: The five men are the speakers, while the priest is the person being told to be quiet.
items.reason: The dialogue turn resolves the roles: the priest asks the five men a question, and “They answered him” identifies those men as the speakers of “Be quiet!” This requires tracking speaker versus recipient rather than merely retrieving a nearby word.
